method: Dated headline EV excludes operating leases while rent remains in EBIT. Target debt contains finance leases. Not fair-value bridges: no adjustment for intervening dividends, restricted/necessary cash, legal claims or subsequent share changes. Cash after capex/SBC is not normalized FCFE; full pretax refund subtraction is conservative sensitivity because actual refund tax cash timing is not isolated.
comparability: Target is a broadline store/online retailer with food/household frequency, owned real estate, larger capex and mixed categories. Best Buy is electronics replacement-cycle exposed with more vendor dependence. No multiple-derived target. Both report August1,2026; share count dates differ. BBY impairment/restructuring distort EBIT beyond refunds, so comparison is not normalized sustainable profitability.
